description: Labelled routing set for backend/app/services/model_router.py. Gold labels encode what the system SHOULD do, not what the current regex does, so that over- and under-triggering both show up as errors. Routes: document_rag_base | muscle_finetuned_v2 | general_base.

route_semantics.document_rag_base: answer strictly from the user's uploaded documents

route_semantics.general_base: everything else — base Gemma, no adapter
